round1.Q2 Whether leaders start on demand from: A: from M1 the daemon starts a role's leader when a message for its role arrives (02 rule 51); stopping idle leaders and a leader's provider choice (rules 52 and 53) come in M5
round1.Q3 How demo paths are recorded before M4: A: every milestone's demo is recorded with an ordinary terminal recorder running in the demo terminal; from M4 on, AsmAI's own per-dispatch recordings are kept alongside
